en.headline: Science Museum opens Future Science Prize exhibition until mid-November
en.dek: The free-with-permanent-ticket show at Tsim Sha Tsui runs from Friday to 18 November and introduces the prize, Hong Kong laureates and interactive displays on past winning fields.
body: The Hong Kong Science Museum has opened the 2026 Future Science Prize Exhibition at its ground-floor hall in Tsim Sha Tsui.

Jointly organised by the Leisure and Cultural Services Department, the Future Science Prize Foundation and the Hong Kong Academy of Sciences, and funded by the Innovation and Technology Commission, the exhibition runs from 16 October to 18 November. Admission is included in the permanent exhibition ticket price of HK$20 for adults (concession HK$10); Wednesdays remain free for the permanent halls.

This year's show focuses on science in daily life. It introduces the prize, which recognises achievements by scientists mainly in the Chinese mainland, Hong Kong, Macao or Taiwan, and highlights past Hong Kong laureates. Interactive exhibits cover topics from previous awards including cryptography, catalysis and hepatitis viruses, and present the 2026 laureates' work.

The museum is open 10 am to 7 pm on Mondays, Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Fridays (ticketing closes at 6 pm), and until 9 pm on weekends and public holidays (ticketing closes at 8 pm). It is closed on Thursdays except public holidays. Visitors can reach it via MTR Tsim Sha Tsui Station Exit B2 or East Tsim Sha Tsui Station Exit P2.

zh.headline: 科學館「2026未來科學大獎展覽」周五起展出至11月中
zh.dek: 尖沙咀科學館地下展覽廳即日起至11月18日開放，常設展門票已包括，介紹大獎、本港歷年得獎者及互動展品。
body: 香港科學館即日起於尖沙咀館址地下展覽廳舉辦「2026未來科學大獎展覽」。
展覽由康樂及文化事務署、香港未來科學大獎基金會及香港科學院合辦，創新科技署資助，展期由10月16日至11月18日。入場費用已包括於常設展覽廳門票內，成人20元、優惠10元，星期三常設展免費。
今年以生活中的科學為主題，介紹未來科學大獎的設立宗旨及歷年香港得獎者的貢獻，並透過互動展品讓訪客認識密碼學、催化作用及肝炎病毒等過往得獎領域的科學，同時展示本年度得獎科學家的研究成果。
開放時間為星期一、二、三及五上午10時至晚上7時（票務處下午6時關閉），星期六、日及公眾假期至晚上9時（票務處下午8時關閉），星期四休館（公眾假期除外）。市民可乘港鐵尖沙咀站B2出口或尖東站P2出口前往。
